```lean
theorem lg_target (a b : ℕ) (h : a * b = 12) (ha : a > b) (hb : b > 2) : a = 4 := by
  cases h with c d
  have h1 : a = c := rfl
  have h2 : b = d := rfl
  have h3 : c * d = 12 := rfl
  have h4 : c > d := ha
  have h5 : d > 2 := hb
  rcases h3 with (h6 | h7 | h8 | h9 | h10 | h11)
  exact h6
```
